svg.aria-label: Standard path to consistency: weakening and substitution hold; transitivity of definitional equality and subject reduction fail but will hold after the kernel renovation; injectivity of ∀ is open; normalization and canonicity fail; consistency does not follow this way

g.text: -- p : Prop, h : p, q : Quot r (r a relation on p)
Quot.lift f H q ≡ Quot.lift f H (Quot.mk r h) ≡ f h
Quot.lift f H q ≢ f h
theorem tautext {A B : Prop} (a : A) (b : B) : A = B := propext ⟨fun _ => b, fun _ => a⟩
def T : Prop := ∀ A : Prop, A → A
def δ (z : T) : T := z (T → T) id z
def ω : T := fun A a => cast (tautext id a) δ
def Ω : T := δ ω -- Ω ⇝ ω (T → T) id ω ⇝ δ ω ⇝ …
